The product

Designed to be seen through

Sanctuary Series — Tier 6

Water that flows
through the walls.

Hydro-wall technology — integrated vertical channels moulded inside the lateral acrylic walls carry water upward and cascade it over the top rim as a continuous laminar curtain. Continuous micro-bubble lines rise along both long lateral walls. Chromotherapy LED (deep royal blue), walnut wood base with amber underglow.

Available in two variants: with integrated IP68 cameras or camera-free. Indicative target from 9,000€ — final price subject to configuration and industrial validation. Bespoke fabrication on request.

Concept stage — prototype not yet built. Production subject to funding.

The concept

There's a moment in the bath when everything else disappears.

The noise, the notifications, the performance. Just you, water, and whatever version of yourself shows up when no one is watching.

We built BATHNOIR for that moment — and then we decided to make it visible. Not to the world. To you.

BATHNOIR is a freestanding bathtub machined from high-grade transparent acrylic, with two IP68-certified cameras integrated flush into the inner walls below the waterline. They point inward. They point upward. They capture what you look like suspended in water, lit by whatever light finds you.

The footage goes to the BATHNOIR app — and nowhere else. No cloud. No servers. Your stream, your device, your rules.

This is luxury redefined: not by what you hide in a room, but by what you choose to see.

Supply chain

Who builds it

We have identified and evaluated our manufacturing supply chain. Nothing is final until the prototype phase confirms performance — but we are not starting from zero.

Acrylic structure

OEM Foshan, Guangdong

Custom cast acrylic freestanding tubs — same manufacturing cluster supplying European luxury bathroom brands. Unit cost: 900–2,500 €.

Camera module (option A)

Hikvision DS-2XC6284G0

8MP, 316L stainless housing, IP68 rated. Anti-corrosion series. Evaluated for standard integration at ~150–300 € / unit.

Camera module (option B)

autoVimation Nautilus

Industrial IP68 underwater enclosure. Higher-spec option evaluated for optical quality in hot water environments.

Control hub

Custom PCB — RPi CM4

Local network only. IP65-rated enclosure. No external connectivity. Your stream never leaves your home network.

Installation

What you need before we ship

BATHNOIR is a freestanding fixture requiring a qualified plumber. Installation is the responsibility of the buyer.

You arrange

Plumber + space

Standard 1½" drain, hot/cold inlets, 230V socket nearby, floor load capacity ~350 kg, 200 × 110 cm clear area minimum.

We provide

Everything else

Printed installation manual, video walkthrough, fitting kit (drain, overflow, cable conduit seal), and a free remote support session on request.

Shipping

Delivered from mainland Spain

We ship insured, on pallet, via DB Schenker / Rhenus from our 3PL warehouse in Valencia. Delivery to ground floor / building entrance.

Risks & challenges

We believe in being direct about this

  • Manufacturing risk. Integrating IP68 cameras into cast acrylic is complex. Integration method may need revision during prototype testing. Optical result may differ slightly from renders.
  • Timeline risk. 2028 is our target. Hardware projects at this scale routinely run 3–6 months longer. We will communicate clearly if that happens.
  • Regulatory risk. CE marking and IP68 certification for an integrated water fixture with electrical components requires third-party testing. We have budgeted for this.
  • What we will not do. Disappear. Every backer gets monthly updates regardless of news. If something material changes, we will say so clearly and offer refunds per Indiegogo policy.
Questions

Frequently asked

Is this legal? Can I really stream from my bathroom?
Yes. The system is entirely private — it streams only to your device, on your local network. No upload, no broadcast, no external storage. You control it completely. Privacy mode disables the cameras instantly with one tap.
Will the acrylic warp or yellow with hot water?
High-grade cast acrylic (PMMA) is rated for continuous water temperatures up to 60°C. We specify 15–20mm wall thickness precisely for structural integrity. The material does not yellow with age at normal bath temperatures.
What if the campaign doesn't reach 30,000 €?
Indiegogo's fixed funding model means you are not charged unless the goal is reached. If we don't hit 30,000 €, your pledge is returned in full.
Does it work with any plumbing?
It connects to standard European plumbing (EN standards). Your plumber will know exactly what to do. We include a full fitting kit and a detailed installation manual.
When will the app be available?
The app will be released to Noir Bath, Noir Suite and Noir Duo backers when the first units ship. It will not be publicly available before that. Lifetime access means all future updates, no subscription, ever.
Can I see a physical unit?
Not yet — the first prototype is what this campaign funds. We will invite backers to a reveal event when the first unit is complete.
